cells.gaps: No rule or standard issued under the policy has been found. No source found says whether departments have set up the committees and appointed the chief data officers the directive requires.
cells.note: The April 2025 public service data governance directive, in effect on signature, names a data governance committee, a data governance office and a chief data officer in every department to carry out its framework. No rule issued under it has been found, so stage 5 is not met.
